description: Java entity class 'CommandSource' representing command source records in the Fineract project, including fields, builder methods, and status management.

classes.name: CommandSource
classes.description: Entity class representing command source records with status management and audit update methods.

methods.name: fullEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates a CommandSource instance from command wrapper, JSON command, user, idempotency key, status, and sanitized flag.

methods.name: getPermissionCode
methods.description: Returns a permission code string combining action and entity names.

methods.name: getStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns the command processing result type enum based on status code.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code based on a CommandProcessingResultType enum.

methods.name: markAsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Marks the command source as awaiting approval.

methods.name: isAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the command source is awaiting approval.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Checks if the command source has been processed.

methods.name: markAsChecked
methods.description: Marks the command source as checked with a checker user.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if the command source has been checked.

methods.name: markAsRejected
methods.description: Marks the command source as rejected with a checker user.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the command source has been rejected.

methods.name: updateForAudit
methods.description: Updates command source fields based on a command processing result for audit purposes.
